div.p:
Physical and logical network topology of the homelab.
The UDM Pro manages 5 VLANs. pve-01 connects directly to the UDM Pro
via two NICs: vmbr0 (VLAN 5 management) and vmbr1 (full VLAN trunk).
pve-01 hosts all clusters and standalone services as Proxmox guests.
Talos VMs use a dual-NIC design: eth0 on vmbr1 for Cilium L2
LoadBalancer ARP announcements, eth1 on the shared talosnet
SDN VNet for inter-node traffic (kubelet, etcd).
Most LXCs/VMs are dual-homed the same way (VLAN 5 + talosnet), including
talosnet-dns, the BIND server nodes use for split-horizon resolution.

g.title: UniFi Dream Machine Pro — L3 gateway, DHCP, inter-VLAN firewall
UniFi Access Point — SSID-to-VLAN mapping (Home/Guest/IoT)
IoT devices
Proxmox hypervisor — 2 physical NICs, both connected directly to UDM Pro

g.text: internet blocked by default — HASS has a VLAN-level internet exception

g.title: PVE OS management bridge — VLAN 5 only (static 10.0.0.11)
Trunks all VLANs to guest VMs and LXC containers
TrueNAS — Garage/nginx app publishing, SMB shares. 3 NICs: ens18 (VLAN 5, this node), ens19 (talosnet, 10.128.0.6 — Garage/nginx reachable from talosnet without SNAT), ens27 (172.31.255.253/30).
Shared VNet (talosnet, simple zone -- not VXLAN, single-node PVE can't create vxlan without peers) for all Talos clusters — SNAT to Proxmox API; DNS 10.128.0.3 via DHCP
Dual-NIC Talos VMs — same eth0/eth1 split for every cluster (rhodes.akn, lungmen.akn, sandbox, ...), each with its own /29 LB slice and talosnet lease.
Omni cluster manager — API, dashboard, Wireguard tunnel. Dual-NIC — also eth1 10.128.0.2 on talosnet.
Observability — VictoriaMetrics, VictoriaLogs, Alertmanager. Dual-NIC — also eth1 10.128.0.5 on talosnet.
OCI container registry (Zot). Dual-NIC — also eth1 10.128.0.4 on talosnet.

BIND — static records for talosnet-only hostnames + split-horizon (RFC2136/TSIG from external-dns), forwards everything else upstream. Dual-NIC, but only serves DNS on eth1 (talosnet) — the VLAN 5 address isn't used for that.
Prometheus PVE exporter — scrapes the Proxmox API for host/VM metrics. Single-NIC (VLAN 5 only).
Omni infrastructure provider for Proxmox — provisions Talos VMs. Single-NIC (VLAN 5 only).

Shared node traffic (eth1) for all Talos/Omni clusters — kubelet, etcd, inter-node; DHCP stable per MAC (.10–.250). Also carries internal-only Cilium LB IPs (.2–.9, .240–.254) for talosnet-only Gateways, 2 per cluster (sandbox excluded).

text.tspan: No node IP — L2 ARP only

g.title: Cilium L2Announcement ARP responses for this cluster's /29 slice of the /26 pool. No node management traffic here — that's eth1.
Node management plane (kubelet, etcd). Also SNATs out to reach the Proxmox API, which proxmox-csi-plugin needs to attach/detach volumes.
